text.body:
agnyādheyabrāhmaṇam brahmavādino vadanti purā vā auddālakirāruṇiruvāca brahmaṇe tvā prāṇāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi brahmaṇe tvāpānāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi brahmaṇe tvā vyānāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi brahmaṇe tvā samānāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi kā etā devatā yāsāmevaitajjuṣṭaṃ nirvapatyṛco ve brahmaṇaḥ prāṇa ṛcāmevetajjuṣṭaṃ nirvapati yajūṃṣi ve brahmaṇo'pāno yajuṣāmevetajjuṣṭaṃ nirvapati sāmāni ve brahmaṇo vyānaḥ sāmnāmevetajjuṣṭaṃ nirvapatyatharvāṇo ve brahmaṇaḥ samāno'tharvaṇāmevetajjuṣṭaṃ nirvapati । catuḥśarāvo bhavati catvāro hīme vedāstāneva bhāginaḥ karoti mūlaṃ vai brahmaṇo vedo vedānāmevetanmūlaṃ yadṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti tadbrahmaudanasya brahmaudanatvam 1
niśi carmanbrahmā brahmaudanaṃ nirvapati rakṣāṃsi ve devānāṃ yajñamājighāṃsaṃstāni brahmaṇāpāghnata brahma brahmā brahmaṇaiva yajñādrakṣāṃsyapahanti । catuḥśarāvo bhavati catasro diśo digbhireva yajñādrakṣāṃsyapahanti । jīvataṇḍulo bhavati saṃpaddhyā । apūto vā eṣo'medhyo'yajñiyo'nṛtamūcivānya ṛṇānyanavadāyāgnimādhatte tamanvārambhayitvā yaddevā devaheḍanaṃ yadadīvyannṛṇamahamityetā āhutīrājyena juhoti punātyevenaṃ pūto medhyo yajñiyo'gnimādhatta ekaviṃśatiretā āhutīrjuhotyasā āditya ekaviṃśa eṣa savitā sa ha devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ tenaivenaṃ savituḥ pavitreṇa punāti yadantarikṣamityagnaya evenametadenasaḥ pramuñcanti saṃkasuko vikasuka ityetadevāsmā agnayo yakṣmaṃ cātayanti kṛtyāṃ nirṛtiṃ saṃ varcasetyāśiṣamevāśāste 2
devāśca vā asurāścāgnyādheyāyopāvasansamāvatkurvāṇā yadeva devā akurvata tadasurā akurvata te devā etamodanamāsādyaitā āhutīrājyenājuhavustadasurā nānvavāyaṃs tato devā abhavanparāsurā abhavanya evaṃ vidvānetamodanamāsādyaitā āhutīrājyena juhoti bhrātṛvyasyānanvavāyāya bhavatyātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati pravedhase kavaya ityuktvodanasya juhoti devānāmeva heḍānyavayajate cāturmāsyānyālapsyamānasya dīkṣiṣyamāṇasyaitā āhutīrājyena juhoti punātyevenaṃ pūto medhyo yajñiyo yajate pūto medhyo yajñiyo dīkṣate । śva ādhāsyamāna rātrīṃ jāgrati tamo vā andhaṃ svapnastamasa evenamandhaso muñcati śilpairgāyanti śilpairhi sarvaṃ kurvanti 3
dhārayatyetamagniṃ na māṃsamaśnīyānna striyamupeyād adhaḥ śayīta na vipravasennāsya gṛhādagnim̐ hareyurnāhareyuranyata ātmano gopīthāyāgnimetamādhāya samidādhānāntaṃ kuryādvaraṃ dadānīti vācaṃ visṛjate 'śānto vā eṣa bhūtvā yajamānamabhyaiti vareṇa caivenaṃ satyayā ca vācā śamayati 4
rathantaraṃ gārhapatya ādhīyamāne gāyatyayaṃ ve loko rathantaramayaṃ gārhapatyo'smiṃstena loke pratitiṣṭhatyagniṃ jyotiravarunddhe vāmadevyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnā ādhīyamāne gāyatyantarikṣaṃ ve vāmadevyamantarikṣaṃ dakṣiṇāgnirantarikṣe tena pratitiṣṭhati vāyuṃ jyotiravarunddhe bṛhadāhavanīya ādhīyamāne gāyatyasau ve loko bṛhadasā āhavanīyo'muṣmiṃstena loke pratitiṣṭhati sūryaṃ jyotiravarunddhe । tadāhurupadhītā vā etasyāgnayo yasyādhīyamāne sāmāni gīyante vatsā hi sāmānyagnīnāṃ te'smai na sarvā āśiṣo duhre tasmātsāmāni na geyānyagnīnāmavidohāya somasya vā etāḥ priyāstanvo yatsāmāni yadanyatra gīyeransomaṃ priyābhistanūbhirvyardhayerannanupanāmuka enaṃ somaḥ syāttasmātsāmāni na geyāni somasyopanatyā । agnimādadhānaḥ sāyamatithiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ nāparundhīta sūryeṇa saheyivāṃsaṃ sūryo vai sāyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ praviśati ya āhitāgneratithirbhavati sa tṛpto'gniṃ praviśati tasmānnāparoddhavyo nāsyānāśvānbrāhmaṇo gṛhe vasetprajāṃ cāsya paśūṃśca sādhukṛtyāścāśnīyāddānāya hyeṣo'gnimādhatte sāyaṃ prātarudite'gnā ahute nāśnīyādatithirvā eṣa āhitāgneḥ pūrvaṃ hyatithimāśayanti । ṛbīsena pakvaṃ nāśnīyācchamalaṃ vā etadagneḥ svakṛta irine nāvasyetklinnaṃ dāru nābhyādadyādanāgneyaṃ hyetannāvyudakamnācāmedyo ve nāvyagniḥ sa āhitāgnimārohati tasya śāntyai nānṛtaṃ vadecchamalaṃ vā etadvāco yadanṛtaṃ śamalagṛhītaḥ syāddvādaśa rātrīrājyenāgnihotraṃ juhuyānnavajātā vā etasyāgnayo yathā kumāraṃ navajātaṃ sarpirāśayantyevameva tadajasro'gnirbhavati rakṣāṃṣi ve bhūtaṃ saṃsañcante bhūta eveṣa devānāṃ yo'gnimādhatte 'gnirdevānāṃ rakṣohā rakṣasāmapahatyā । ahataṃ vasīta medhyatvāyātho satejastvāyā 'dhvaryave vāsasī parihite dadātyeṣa hyenaṃ virāji pratiṣṭhāpayati tadeṣābhyanūktā । uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pratiranta āyurityagnīṣomīye patyā vasane dadāti sameva jīryato mithunau gāvau deyau mithunasyāvaruddhyā atho brahmacārī bhavatyātmano gopīthāya 5
gāro vā eṣo'gnīnāṃ yadgārhapatyo 'yaṃ vāveka āsīnnāhavanīyo na dakṣiṇāgniste devāḥ saha jāyābhirgārhapatye'nnādyamapacaṃste paktvā samaśanaṃ prāśnanyā devapatnayastā hi yantīnna prāśnantīti te devā aviduryajñaveśasamidaṃ kurmetyagniṃ vibhajāmetyagniṃ vyabhajaṃstasya yo'gnestṛtīyo bhāgastaṃ devāḥ śvo bhūte prāñcamanayansa devebhya āhavanīyo'bhavattadāhavanīyasyāhavanīyatvaṃ tasmācchvaḥ śvaḥ prāṅpraṇīyate tasya yo'gnestṛtīyo bhāgastaṃ devapitaraḥ paryagṛhṇandakṣiṇato'nayansa dakṣiṇāgnirabhavattaddakṣiṇāgnerdakṣiṇāgnitvaṃ yathā ve vṛṣalayonijaḥ putrakaḥ sarvamatti medhyaṃ cāmedhyaṃ caivaṃ vai bhrāṣṭrāgniḥ sarvamatti medhyaṃ cāmedhyaṃ cā'suryo vā eṣa yadbhrāṣṭrāgniryattasmiñjuhotyasuryā asyāhutayo bhavantyasurebhyo vā eṣa purā pakvaṃ pacati na pitṛbhyo'tha yaḥ kāmayetāmapakvaṃ me pitṛbhyo bhāgadheyaṃ bhavatviti gārhapatyādagniṃ praṇīyāhutīrjuhuyādāmapakvamevāsya pitṛbhyo bhāgadheyaṃ bhavati tasya yastṛtīyo bhāgastaṃ devapatnayaḥ paryagṛhṇansa gārhapatyo'bhavattadgārhapatyasya gārhapatyatvaṃ tasmātpariśrite gārhapatye patnīḥ saṃyājayantyājyahaviṣo bhavanti reto vā ājyaṃ retasaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante prajananāya । maṇḍalaṃ gārhapatyasya lakṣaṇaṃ kuryānmaṇḍalo hyayaṃ loko'nena lokena saṃmitaṃ candrā rdhaṃ dakṣiṇāgneścandrā rdhaṃ hyanta-rikṣamantarikṣeṇa saṃmitaṃ svargo lokaścaturaśrastasmādāhavanīyaścaturaśraḥ svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai 6
brahmavādino vadanti devānāṃ vā etānyāyatanāni yadgārhapatyaśca dakṣiṇāgniścāhavanīyaśca maṇḍalaṃ gārhapatyasya lakṣaṇaṃ kuryānmaṇḍalo hyayaṃ loko'ṣṭāviṃśatyaṅgulo bhavati śakvaryā saṃmitaḥ saptapadā śakvarī śākvarāḥ paśavaḥ paśūnevāvarunddhe । candrārdhaṃ dakṣiṇāgneścandrārdhaṃ hyantarikṣamantarikṣeṇa saṃmitaṃ deva-tānāṃ vā etadannaṃ yaccandra mā devatā evāsyānnamādayati dvātriṃśadaṅgulo bhava-tyanuṣṭubhā saṃmito'nuṣṭubhā vīryaṃ karotyanuṣṭubheva vīryeṇa yajamānaṃ samardhayati । caturaśramāhavanīyasya kuryāccaturaśro hyasau loko'ratnimātro bhavatyetāvānhyātmā prajāpatinā saṃmito'nnaṃ ve prajāpatirannādyenaivenaṃ samardhayati । hutvāgnīnava-sṛjetprajayā ca paśubhiśca prajāyate 'thāhuravasṛṣṭo hyṛṣabho vardhata iti divo mātrayā variṇā prathasveti prathayatyeva yathā dīpyamāno bhūyo'bhyādadhātyevamevāsmiṃ-stadabhipūrvaṃ tejo dadhāti tadāhuḥ kaḥ śreyāṃsaṃ viṣuptaṃ bodhayitumarhatīti tasmānnāvasṛjed । ya evameṣāmāyatanaṃ vedāyatanavānbhavati yasyaivaṃ viduṣo yasyaivaṃ vidvānagnīnviharati vasīyānbhavati 7
devā ve sarve sametya prajāpatimapṛcchankutastretāgnirbhaviṣyatīti sa ūrdhvapādo'dhastādbhūmyāṃ śiraḥ kṛtvā divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tapo'tapyata tasyāśrūṇi parāpatannaśruṣvevāśvo'jāyata sa vyavartata sa vyadhūnuta sa śakṛdakarotsa parāvṛtyājighrattataḥ śakāchvasyajāyata tatpārśvānmadhyāccāśvasadyatpārśvānmadhyāccāśvasattadaśvattho'jāyata tasya vedo mūlaṃ parṇāni chandāṃsi śākhāḥ śākhā-ntarāṇyevameṣa sa śamīgarbhastacchamīgarbhasya śamīgarbhatvam 8
devā ve sarve sametya prajāpatimapṛcchankiṃ vāyamagnirmithunātsaṃbhavatyatho araṇyā athottarāditi tānprajāpatirabravīdyathā ve puruṣaḥ striyamupetya tatastriguṇā-nmithunātparimathyamānātpuruṣādre taḥ saṃbhavatyetadvai viṣṇurūpaṃ yaduttarāraṇista-dgāyatr! yā rūpaṃ tasmādetasmānmithunādagnirmathyamāno jāyate dvādaśāṅgula uttaro bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarasyāptyai tryodaśāṅgulaṃ chattraṃ bhavati traya ime lokā daṣa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarasyāptyai triṣavaṇaṃ netraṃ bhavati traya ime lokā eṣveva lokeṣvṛdhnoti 9
agnirvai devebhyo'pākrāmatsa pratyaṅṅuddravattasmādadhvaryuḥ pratyaṅmukho'gniṃ manthati yatpratyaṅmukho'gniṃ manthati tamevāgnimāhvayate tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvatīti yaddhūme sāma gāyati devebhya evenaṃ nivedayati gātuvittamamiti yadagnau sāma gāyati devebhya evenaṃ nividaṃ karoti bālo vā eṣo'gnistejasvīni sāmāni tasmādagnyādheye sāmāni na gīyante tejo hyeṣāmeṣa na sahati rodanti va āhitāgneragnayo yasya prāksome sāmāni gīyante tasmātsome geyāni na prāksome 'gnīnāmagnitvāyātho satejastvāya 10
caturviṃśatyaṅgulāraṇirbhavati caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī gāyatryā saṃmitā ṣaḍaṅgulapṛthvī ṣaḍvā ṛtava ṛtuṣveva pratitiṣṭhatyaro vai viṣṇustasya vā eṣā patnī yadaraṇistadaraṇyā araṇītvam tasyā yānyagre catvāryaṅgulāni tacchiro yadanyāni catvāryaṅgulāni sā grīvā yadanyāni catvāryaṅgulāni taduraḥ stano bāhū pārśve pṛṣṭhamudaraṃ ca yadanyāni catvāryaṅgulāni sā śroṇī yadanyāni catvāryaṅgulāni tadūrū jānunī yadanyāni catvāryaṅgulāni tajjaṅghe pādā ityetāvataivāraṇiḥ sarvairaṅgaiḥ saṃpūrṇā bhavati yacchīrṣṇi manthati śirorogeṇa yajamānaḥ pramīyate yadāsye vāgvikalo bhavati yadgrīvāyāṃ tadgadgado bhavati yadaṃsayostatpakṣahato bhavati yadudare kṣudhā yajamānaḥ pramīyate yadūrvostadyātudhānānāṃṅghayostatpiśācānāṃ yatpādayostatkravyādānāṃ yacchroṇyāṃ manthati tatsarveṣāṃ devānāṃ tena yajamānaḥ svaryo bhavati ya evaṃ veda prathame manthane sthānakalpā nānetareṣvanṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati ya evaṃ veda 11 ityagnyādheyabrāhmaṇam
amābrāhmaṇam devāśca vā asurāścāpāṃ rasamamanthaṃstasmānmathyamānādamṛtamudatiṣṭhattato yaḥ sarvato rasaḥ samasravatsa somastatsomasya somatvaṃ candramā vai somastaṃ devāḥ kalaśo bhakṣayanti ṣoḍaśakalaḥ puruṣo lometi dve akṣare tvagiti dve asṛgiti dve māṃsamiti dve snāyviti dve asthīti dve meda iti dve majjeti dve tāḥ ṣoḍaśa saṃpadyante sa eṣa ṣoḍaśakalaḥ puruṣaḥ somasya tasya vasavaḥ pañca kalā abhakṣayanta pṛthivīṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā te'mṛtatvamakāmayanta te'mṛtatvamajayaṃstato ve te'mṛtāstṛptāḥ prītā abhavaṃstasya rudrāḥ pañca kalā abhakṣayantāntarikṣaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā te'mṛtatvama-kāmayanta te'mṛtatvamajayaṃstato ve te'mṛtāstṛptāḥ prītā abhavaṃstasyādityāḥ pañca kalā abhakṣayanta divaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā te'mṛtatvamakāmayanta te'mṛtatvamajayaṃstato ve te'mṛtāstṛptāḥ prītā abhavannekā kalodaśiṣyata tāṃ prajāpatiḥ sinīvālyā adadāttayeha paśuṣu vanaspatiṣvoṣadhīṣu cāmāvasadyadamāvasattadamāvasyāyā amāvasyātvam tayā prātardadarśa yaddadarśa taddarśasya darśatvaṃ taṃ devā yāgata āpyāyitāḥ punarapyāpyāyayanta sa pūrṇaḥ paurṇamāsīmupāvasattatpaurṇamāsyāḥ pau-rṇamāsītvaṃ tasmādāhurdarśapūrṇamāsayājāīṃm̐! llokānabhijayanneti somasya sārṣṭitāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti ya evaṃ vidvāndarṣapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate iti amābrāhmaṇam
....brāhmaṇam catvāri śṛṅgā iti vedā vā etaduktāḥ trayo asya pādā iti trīṇi savanāni dve śīrṣe iti prāyaṇīyodayanīye sapta hastāsa iti sapta chandāṃsi tasmātsaptārciṣaḥ sapta samidhaḥ sapta ime lokā yeṣu caranti prāṇā guhāśayā nihitāḥ sapta sapta tridhā baddha iti tredhā baddho mantrabrāhmaṇakalpaiḥ ṛṣabho rauravīti rauravaṇamasya savanakrameṇa ṛgbhiryajurbhiḥ sāmabhiratharvabhiryadenamṛgbhiḥ śaṃsanti yajurbhiryajanti sāmabhiḥ stuvantyatharvabhirjapanti । maho deva iti mahādevo । martyām̐ āviveśa manuṣyā-ṇāṃ tasyottarā bhūyāṃsi nirvacanāya । catvāri śṛṅgā caturmukhāścaturvedāścaturyugā agnayaścatvāro'bhavan svayaṃ kailāsaparvato nāma eko bhavati tadekaśṛṅgaṃ dviśṛṅgaṃ daśaśṛṅgaṃ dvādaśaśṛṅgaṃ viṃśaśṛṅgaṃ dvāviṃṣaśṛṅgaṃ triṃśaśṛṅgaṃ dvātriṃśaśṛṅgaṃ śataśṛṅgaṃ sahasraśṛṅgaṃ koṭiśṛṅgamana-ntaśṛṅgaṃ meruśṛṅgaṃ sphaṭikaśṛṅgaṃ pitṛśṛṅgaṃ manuṣyaśṛṅgaṃ dvādaśādityānāṃ pūrvāpāraṃ munayo vadanti sarvamāyuḥ sarvametyāyuḥ sarvameti ya evaṃ veda
graheṣṭibrāhmaṇam devāśca vā asurāśca samāvadeva yajñe'kurvata yadeva devā akurvata tadasurā akurvata te devā etāni grahahavīm̐ ṣyapaśyam̐ stairindramayājayam̐ sta asurā nānvavāyam̐ stato devā abhavanparāsurā abhavanya evaṃ vidvānetāni grahahavīm̐ ṣi yajate bhrātṛvyasyānanva-vāyāya bhavatyātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavatyādityāya ghṛte caruṃ nirvapettejastena parikrīṇāti śaukraṃ caruṃ brahmavarcasaṃ tena parikrīṇāti bṛhaspataye naivāraṃ payasi caruṃ vākpatyaṃ tena parikrīṇāti bodhāya vavakapālaṃ buddhiṃ tena parikrīṇāti bhaumāyekakapālaṃ yaśastena parikrīṇāti saurāya palalamiśraṃ ghṛte caruṃ surabhiṃ tena parikrīṇāti candramase pañcadaśakapālamāyustena parikrīṇāti rāhave carumabhayaṃ tena parikrīṇāti ketāve carumanaparodhaṃ tena parikrīṇātyetānyeva sarvāṇi bhavati ya evaṃ vidvānetayā yajeta । ājyenopahomāñjuhotyāśiṣāmavaruddhyā etayā yajeta yaḥ kāmayeta tejasvī bhrājasvī vākpatirbuddhimānyaśasvī surabhirāyuṣāṃnabhayyanaparuddhī syāmityekacakramudayādbhrājamānamityaṣṭādaśa yājyānuvākyā bhavanti sarūpatvāyā 'gnirhiraṇyaṃ somo hiraṇyamityājyabhāgau preddho agna imo agna iti saṃyājye uccairyajatyeṣā vai vācāmuttamā yoccairuttamaḥ samānānāṃ bhavatyādityastejasvītyupahomāñjuhoti sarvasyāptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyai ya evaṃ vidvānetayā yājeta
upanayanabrāhmaṇam brahmacaryamāgāmityāha brahma ve brahmā brahmaṇaivātmānaṃ paridadhāti tampṛcchati kornāmāsīti prajāpatirvai ko nāma prājāpatyamevenaṃ kṛtvā bandhumantamupanayati bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityāhemānevāsmai tattrīṃ llokānannādyāya prayacchati bhūriti vā ayaṃ loko bhuvarityantarikṣaṃ svarityasau loka imānevāsmai tattrīnvedānannādyāya prayacchati bhūriti vā ṛco bhuvariti yajūṃṣi svariti sāmānyadhīte haiteṣāṃ vedāṇāmekaṃ dvau trīntsarvānvā yamevaṃ vidvānupanayate tamāha kāya tvā paridadāmīti ko ve prajāpatiḥ prajāpataya evenaṃ tatparidadāti na brahmacarī mriyate nāsya brahmacarī saṃmriyate yamevaṃ vidvānupanayate tamāha devāya tvā savitre paridadāmīti savitā ha vā idaṃ yadyatprajābhyaḥ prasavati tattatkurvanti sa yadātmanā kuryānna tanmanyetāhamidaṃ karomīti savitā me'sāvīdityeva tanmanyeta yaddha ve kalyāṇaṃ tadasmai savitā prasavati nāsmai pāpam̐ savitā prasuvate yamevaṃ vidvānupanayate tamāha bṛhaspataye tvā paridadāmīti brahma ve bṛhaspatirbrahmaṇa evenaṃ tatparidadāti na brahmacārī mriyate nāsya brahmacārī saṃmriyate yamevaṃ vidvānupanayate tamāha brahmacāryasīti brahma vā annādyamannādyamevāsmiṃstaddadhātyatho annādyaṃ vā śrāddhabrāhmaṇam asurāṇāṃ vā ime lokā āsaṃste devā abruvan yo ve yaṃ lokaṃ ujjeṣyati sa tasmai bhaviṣyatīti te vasava imaṃ lokamajayannantarikṣaṃ rudrā divamādityāste vasava imaṃ lokaṃ jitvāntarikṣaṃ parāpataṃste rudrā nabruvan yanno jayema tannaḥ sahāsaditi te vasavo rudrāścāntarikṣaṃ jitvā divaṃ parāpatam̐ sta ādityānabruvan yanno jayema tannaḥ sahāsaditi te vasavo rudrā ścādityāścāmuṃ lokaṃ jitvemāneva lokānasurānabhyabhavam̐ stato devā abhavanparāsurā abhavanvasavaḥ pitaro rudrāḥ pitāmahā ādityāḥ prapitāmahāstasmādāhurdevāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devā iti yo ve devānāṃ somapāḥ pitarastānudapātraistarpayanti tasmāttrirekasyāpaḥ pradīyante dvirekasya sakṛdekasya tatṣaṭsaṃpadyate yathājitamevopalabhante yadannāṇtamudakaṃ saṃpibanti tatsaptamaṃ yadubhayatomūlaistilamiśraṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ yatpātryā piṇḍapariṣekastannavamaṃ yadudakumbhaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ prohanti taddaśamaṃ tena daśodakaṃ śrāddhamucyate taddaśa daśākṣarā virāḍannaṃ virāḍvirājyevānnādye pratitiṣṭhati 1
pitaro ve putraṃ jāyamānamanvāyannasmākaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāditi so'bravītkadāhaṃ śrāddhaṃ karavāṇīti te'bruvanhasticchāyāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ dadyādyaḥ kāmayeta na punardadyāditi hastī ve bhūtvā svarbhānuramumādityaṃ chāyayābhyabhavattaṃ devapitara āpyāyayannetadvai devapitṝṇāmāyatanaṃ yaddhasticchāyā tasmāddhasticchāyāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ dadyādyaḥ kāma-yetākṣayyamaparimitamanantaṃ bhūyaḥ syādityakṣayyamevāparimitamanantaṃ bhūyo bhavati ya evaṃ vidvāṅhasticchāyāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ dadāti pitṝṇāmakṣayyatvāya 2 dvau ve panthānau devayānaśca pitṛyānaścāgnihotreṇa ve devāḥ svargaṃ lokamāyanpitṛyajñena pitṛlokaṃ tasmādubhau yaṣṭavyau devayānaśca pitṛyānaścobhābhyāṃ vā etatsvargaṃ lokametyāhuranyasmiṃ lloke samidhā pratyatiṣṭhannannādyaṃ ca brāhmaṇe-bhyo'pāsaram̐ stebhyo'bruvannagnau kurmāgnau kariṣyāmyagnau karavāṇīti te'bruvankuruta kuruṣva kriyatāmiti yaṃ kāmayeta prajāvānsyāditi tasya yajñe kuruteti brūyādyaṃ kāmayeta paśumānsyāditi tasya yajñe kuruṣveti brūyādyaṃ kāmayeta vasīyānsyāditi tasya yajñe kriyatāmiti brūyādagnīṣomīyaṃ vā etaddhaviryadagnaukaraṇa-magnīṣomīyenaivetaddhavyenāsmiṃ lloke yajamāno vasīyānbhavati 3
mano vā eṣa yuṅkte yo yakṣyamāṇo yuṅkte nahi manasā yajñastāyate sa yajño bhavatyatha śraddhatte śraddadhānaṃ ve pitaro'nvāyanti vṛddhiṃ śrutvā yadvṛddhiśrāddhaṃ kurvanti tenāsya te'bhīṣṭāḥ prītā bhavantīndro ve prajākāmaḥ pitṛyajñenāyajattasyāsurā yajñamaji-ghāṃsam̐ stānviśve devā upāghnanyadvaiśvadevaṃ purastātkurvantyasurāṇāmapahatyai prācīna-pravaṇe deyaṃ prācīnapravaṇo ve vajro vajreṇaiva yajñādra kṣāṃsyapahanti dakṣiṇāgrā-ścodagagrāśca darbhā bhavanti dakṣiṇāgrebhirvā asya pitaraḥ samupasarantyudagagrebhi-rdevāstasmādbrāhmaṇebhya āvṛttā darbhāḥ pradīyante pitṝṇāmupasaratvāyevamasya pitaraḥ samupasarantyantarhitā hyamuṣmādādityatpitaro'tho antarhitā hi devebhyaśca manuṣyebhyaśca pitara upamūlaṃ barhirdāti tena pitṝṇāṃ yadṛtemūlaṃ tena devānāmubhaye hījyante'ntarhitā hi vīkṣayā manuṣyasyaivamiva hi te'ntarhitā bhavanti 4 iti śrāddhabrāhmaṇam
